ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Punctuation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Punctuation.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Punctuation.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Punctuation.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Punctuation.

2. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. happiness
   B. run
   C. quickly
   D. blue

3. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.

4. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a describing word
   B. Only a joining word
   C. Only an action
   D. A person, place, thing, or idea

5. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the Library
   B. Where is the library
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the library?

6. When practising Language Activities at home, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Language Activities at home.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Activities at home.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Language Activities at home.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Language Activities at home.

7. When practising Spelling, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Spelling.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Spelling.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Spelling.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Spelling.

8. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Only one word repeated
   B. One main idea with supporting sentences
   C. No full stops
   D. Many unrelated topics with no link

9. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.

10. When practising Guided Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Guided Writing.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Guided Writing.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Writing.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Guided Writing.

11. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goes
   B. goed
   C. went
   D. going

12. When practising Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Attentive Listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Attentive Listening.

13. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.

14. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Spelling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive Listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
